run_test_cifar_resnet: run the test suite for CIFAR ResNet models to validate parameter counts and integration
test_is_valid_model_name: test cifar_resnet.Model.is_valid_model_name to validate model name strings like cifar_resnet_20
test_get_model_from_name: test cifar_resnet.Model.get_model_from_name to instantiate ResNet models by name with an initializer
test_count_parameters: test the count_parameters method to verify total parameter counts for ResNet20, ResNet110, and WRN14_128
test_integration_forward_backward: test the integration flow that creates a model, fetches CIFAR-10 data, and runs a forward and backward pass
